sn22.98:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.98:1.3: atthi nu kho bhante, kiñci rūpaṃ yaṃ rūpaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati?
sn22.98:1.4: atthi nu kho bhante, kāci vedanā …pe… atthi nu kho bhante,
sn22.98:1.5: kāci saññā …pe… atthi nu kho bhante,
sn22.98:1.6: keci saṅkhārā …pe… atthi nu kho bhante,
sn22.98:1.7: kiñci viññāṇaṃ, yaṃ viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassatīti.
sn22.98:1.8: natthi kho bhikkhu, kiñci rūpaṃ yaṃ rūpaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati.
sn22.98:1.12: kiñci viññāṇaṃ yaṃ viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassatīti.
